title: Java data types trace event state
description: Shape of the `state` field for java-data-types trace events: a list of typed variable slots plus an optional one-line computation note.

category.description: primitive (value held directly), wrapper (boxed primitive object), or other reference type

type.description: declared type, e.g. int, double, char, Integer, String

bits.description: size in bits for a primitive; null for a reference/wrapper

value.description: the value shown in the slot

range.description: value range for a primitive; null otherwise

note.description: An optional one-line computation shown beside the slots, e.g. an overflow, cast, or comparison.
